name: Cafe Closedown
source: Noah, an owner of a quaint cafe in an MMORPG, is in a tight situation due to financial issues, caused by none other than being forced to buy monster item drops sold by players! Make the right choices for Noah to get this situation under control.
translation: 诺亚是大型多人在线角色扮演游戏中一家古朴咖啡馆的老板，却因财务问题陷入困境——而这一切都是因为玩家强迫他买下掉落的怪物道具！作出正确选择，帮助诺亚控制局面。
